title: 满分十分的热水澡  (Five-Star Showers)

segments.t: Twenty minutes later in the sunny café corner, Hao walks down looking refreshed as Qing pours coffee and anxious Manager Zhou hovers close by. Listen first.
小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
什么？满分十分？
周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
成都旅游指南？等等——你们以为我是酒店评审员？
昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
'Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.' Notice how
晴朗
uses the exact character from Qing's own name—meaning clear, sunny, cloudless skies.
志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
'Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?' Asking 'slept well?' links 'sleep' to 'good' with the degree marker, then tucks the question word at the very end.
这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
'Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!' Remember 'fragrant' from Mei's bread rolls? Paired with 'sleep', it means sleeping soundly and sweetly!
老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
'Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.' Tiny timing word
才
before 'hot' signals that something took a long wait before finally happening.
请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
'Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!' Putting 'down-come' onto 'write' gives
写下来
putting spoken praise permanently onto the page.
周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
'What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!' Clarifying phrase
意思
means 'meaning', so 'Manager Zhou's meaning is...' rescues awkward slips smoothly.
成都旅游指南？等等——你们以为我是酒店评审员？
'The Chengdu Travel Guide? Wait—did you think I am a hotel inspector?' Mistaken word:
以为
almost always introduces what someone wrongly assumed: 'you thought I was...'.
哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
'Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!' Laughter in characters:
哈哈
is pronounced just like English 'haha!'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
什么？满分十分？
周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
成都旅游指南？等等——你们以为我是酒店评审员？
昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
Manager Zhou gave away their secret in record time, and instead of looking stern, Hao smiled warmly. Let's step out into the courtyard next time to learn his real job. See you next time.
回头见！
